decisions.reason: The CSM supplier defines specification and DLR fixed-point terminology independently of the translated-potential construction. The QSM Definition supplies its own finite conditional energies and positive normalized weights; lem-qsm-diagonal-ising-specification-consistency steps 1.1, 2.1 and 2.2 directly prove finite-range measurability, properness and nested consistency for position-dependent coefficients. Its step 3.1 restricts identification with the translated-shape CSM construction to constant fields and translation-invariant couplings. No unsupported extension of the CSM translated-potential theorem is used.

The actual current def-qsm-bounded-finite-range-interaction defines alpha_t^Lambda(A)=exp(it H_Lambda/hbar) A exp(-it H_Lambda/hbar) for a fixed hbar>0; thm-qsm-finite-range-spin-dynamics F4 repeats exactly that convention. In the assigned proof, once the volume contains every nonzero term meeting X, H_Lambda=K_X+L with [L,A]=[L,K_X]=0, so its finite conjugation equals the asserted formula for every real t before taking the norm limit. There is no time-scale mismatch.

The precise Statement fixes d=1, uniform finite real J,h, nearest-neighbor couplings, beta>0 and hbar>0 within the diagonal model, and explicitly identifies its conclusion as longitudinal with no transverse field. Step 1.1 identifies exactly the unordered-edge classical chain energy; step 2.1 transfers the classical singleton DLR set through the full-algebra bijection. The title is a short description of this explicitly restricted theorem and does not assert a separate transverse-field result.

The specialization leaves the positive physical-time scale and KMS strip implicit, although its correspondence supplier explicitly requires hbar>0 and strip width beta*hbar. This is a nonfatal explicitness defect: the inherited interaction/dynamics and KMS definitions already fix a positive scale, so no new model restriction is needed. The repair states that inherited scale and convention in the Statement, both Given paragraphs and F2. The energies, strict Dobrushin condition, full-algebra conclusion and proof steps remain unchanged.
